app.footerTagline: ProofSaathi · A clearer way to handle disputes
app.footerDemo: Demo workspace · No real payments or customer messages
app.translationNote: Translations are a demo draft and need review by a native speaker.

landing.body: ProofSaathi keeps your proof, deadlines, and response in one clear place, so you can get back to running your shop.
landing.assurance: One case at a time. Every step clearly explained.
landing.invoiceLinkedSub: Proof is available in the case
landing.deliveryNeededSub: Ask the right staff member for help
landing.clearSub: Open the case to see what to do
landing.howTitle: From a new dispute to a clear response.
landing.howBody: No complicated reports to decode. Start with the dispute, see what is missing, and move through each step.
landing.b1Body: A simple case list shows the amount, deadline, missing proof, and next step for every dispute.
landing.b2Body: Keep invoices, order details, delivery records, and staff replies linked to the right case.
landing.b3Body: Review the evidence, approve the response, and follow the submission through to its receipt.
landing.finalTitle: See every dispute in one place.
landing.finalBody: Open a case to view its checklist, evidence, staff replies, and next action.

cases.sidebarNote: Your dispute workspace · Every step in one place
cases.heroBody: See what needs attention, follow the evidence, and track each response to a verified submission.
cases.flowTitle: The full response flow, in view.
cases.flowBody: Open a dispute for the live stage, source evidence, staff messages, tool actions, and recorded result.
cases.title: Disputes
cases.intro: Search and open a case to follow its evidence, decisions, and submission.
cases.empty: No dispute cases for this merchant.
cases.noMatch: No cases match this view or search.

chart.title: Disputes at a glance
chart.body: Each column is a count of real cases in this workspace. Open the table below to see each one.

lostNoDebit.title: Dispute closed — provider reports LOST
lostNoDebit.detail: Any debit appears on a later settlement; none reported yet.

won.title: Dispute closed — provider reports WON (simulated outcome)

monitoring.title: Submission verified — dispute outcome pending
monitoring.detail: Verified by an independent simulator receipt and a status read. This is not a win.

uncertain.title: Submission uncertain — reconciling with the provider
uncertain.detail: The provider effect is unknown; status and receipts are read before any retry.

submitting.title: Submitting to the Paytm simulator…
submitting.detail: Policy checks passed for this pack.

deadline.title: Deadline passed — submissions are blocked
deadline.detail: A person must decide next steps.

contradiction.title: Submission blocked: contradiction found
contradiction.detail: Corrected evidence or a source-backed exclusion is required.

review.title: Needs human review
review.detail: A reviewer must decide before the case continues.

waiting.title: Waiting for staff evidence
waiting.detail: The case resumes when staff reply or upload.

guide.closedText: The response and outcome are recorded below.
guide.waitingText: {{who}} has been asked for {{what}}. The case can move forward when the right document arrives.
guide.reviewText: The evidence needs a human decision. Open the review section to see what needs approval.
guide.submittedText: The response has been sent or is being reconciled. Check the receipt and provider status below.
guide.missingText: Please add {{what}} so the response can be checked.
guide.defaultText: The required evidence is available. Check the findings and the response pack before submission.

checklist.order_linkage: Transaction/order linkage for the disputed order
checklist.invoice: Invoice for the disputed order and amount
checklist.delivery_record: Delivery record linking the order to a delivery date

journey.title: What happens next?
journey.intro: These steps follow recorded case activity. Open any step to see its source and available action.
journey.roleNote: Agent and manual tool buttons require the owner or operator identity. Use the demo identity selector above to switch roles.
journey.progress: {{done}} of {{total}} stages have related activity. Human review may be skipped when it is not needed.
journey.requested: {{action}} requested. The case will refresh from recorded events.
journey.requestedRun: {{action}} requested · run {{run}}. The case will refresh from recorded events.
journey.s1Text: Ask the case assistant to check the record and suggest the next safe action. You can also use the controls below yourself.
journey.s2Text: Inspect the checklist and ask staff for a document when a required item is missing.
journey.s3TextBlocked: A blocking contradiction needs corrected proof or a reviewer decision.
journey.s3Text: Check the order, invoice, and delivery record against each other.
journey.s4Text: Ask a person to decide when documents disagree or the next step is uncertain.
journey.s5Text: Freeze the validated documents and citations into a versioned evidence pack.
journey.s6Text: Send the reviewed response. The app checks the pack, your role, and the deadline first.
journey.s7Text: Check that the response arrived. The final dispute decision may come later.
journey.branches: When the case takes another path
journey.b1Title: Staff reply, voice note or reminder
journey.b1Text: Follow the request in the staff inbox. Testimony is labelled separately from documentary proof.
journey.b2Text: Inspect the simulator event, correct the document if needed, then reconcile the provider status.
journey.b3Text: A reviewer records the reason and confirms any concession through the protected two-step flow.

reminder.label: Staff reminder
reminder.failed: Reminder could not be scheduled. Staff can still reply in the inbox.
reminder.sent: Reminder sent to the staff inbox

reasons.superseded: a newer request replaced this one

welcome.title: Welcome to ProofSaathi
welcome.langBody: You can change it any time from the top of the page.
welcome.roleTitle: Who are you in this demo?
welcome.roleBody: Each person sees only what they need. You can switch later.
welcome.ownerBody: The disputed payment is yours. You see each case, collect proof and approve the response sent to Paytm.
welcome.staffBody: You work in the shop and keep records such as delivery slips. Requests reach you in your language and you reply from your phone.
welcome.reviewerWho: Ravi, the shop's manager or accountant
welcome.reviewerBody: Decides the hard cases, such as documents that disagree. Only the reviewer can accept the customer's claim.
welcome.paytmNote: Paytm is not a person here. It is the payment company that receives your response (simulated in this demo).

progress.label: Case progress
progress.s1Hint: Gather the documents the response needs
progress.s2Hint: Review the pack and send it to Paytm

assistant.working: The assistant is working on this case
assistant.waiting: The assistant is waiting for someone
assistant.ready: The assistant can check this case for you
assistant.off: The assistant is off — you can do every step yourself
assistant.workingText: It reads the case, asks staff for missing proof and prepares the response. Every step it takes is shown here.
assistant.waitingText: It asked for something and will continue when the reply or document arrives.
assistant.readyText: It reads the case and takes the next safe step. The system checks every step first.
assistant.offText: No AI model is connected right now. Use the buttons under Response to move the case forward.
assistant.pausedText: The AI model is unavailable. Manual steps still work.
assistant.limits: The assistant can never accept the customer's claim, give refunds or send after the deadline.

staff.title: Requests for you
staff.intro: When the shop needs a document from you, it appears here in your language. Reply, upload the document or send a voice note.
staff.chooseBody: Pick your name to see your requests.

tour.title: Guide
tour.noVoice: This device has no voice for this language. The text stays on screen.

landing.x1: When a customer says they did not get their order, Paytm holds the payment as a dispute. ProofSaathi helps you answer with proof before the deadline.
landing.x2: Shop owners handle cases, staff send documents and reviewers decide hard cases. Use Change role at the top to switch.
landing.x3: Press View disputes to see every case, its deadline and the next step.

cases.x1: Each row is one dispute: how much money is at risk, how much time is left and what to do next.
cases.x2: Cases with the nearest deadline are at the top. Use Urgent only to see just those.
cases.x3: Press Open case to see its progress and the next step.

case.x1: Collect proof, then check and send, then wait for the result. The highlighted stage is where the case is now.
case.x2: The Next step card says in plain words what is missing and who is doing it.
case.x3: Let the assistant check the case, or press Do it myself and use the buttons under Response. Both go through the same safety checks.
case.x4: Proof shows every document and voice note. History shows every recorded step.
case.t5: Nothing is a win until Paytm says so
case.x5: After sending, the case shows a verified receipt. The final result comes later from Paytm.

staff.x1: When the shop needs a document, the request appears here in your language.
staff.x2: Type a reply, upload the document, or send a voice note explaining what happened.
staff.t3: A voice note is not proof
staff.x3: A voice note explains. The case still needs the actual delivery document.

evidence.checklistNote: Demo policy for goods-not-received disputes, not a bank guarantee.
evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.upload: Upload evidence (TXT, JSON, PDF; images need OCR)
evidence.noText: No extractable text ({{error}}). The original file is preserved.

panels.actionsIntro: See what the assistant tried and why. You can also choose an action yourself; the case checks whether it is safe to proceed.
panels.reasonerUnavailable: Reasoner unavailable: {{error}}. Manual operation still works.

explain.request_evidence: Asked a staff member for the missing document.
explain.validate_evidence: Checked the available records for gaps and contradictions.
explain.build_evidence_pack: Prepared a response pack linked to its source documents.
explain.submit_defense: Sent the approved response to the provider simulator.
explain.get_submission_status: Checked whether the provider received the response.
explain.request_human_review: Paused for a person to review the case.

panels.explainDefault: This action was recorded on the case.
panels.switchRole: Switch to the owner or operator identity to run actions.
panels.runsIntro: Each entry is a recorded run. A denied step means the safety checks stopped that action.
panels.runNoLog: A run was recorded in the case timeline. Its detailed tool log is not available in this view yet.
panels.noRuns: No assistant run has been recorded yet. Start one above, or use a case action directly.
panels.verifiedDetail: Receipt {{receipt}} matches pack v{{version}} (independent simulator receipt plus status read).

testimony.audioLoading: Original audio is stored; loading the player…
testimony.hashMismatch: stored text hash does not match
testimony.beyond: (time reported by the provider is beyond the audio length)
testimony.noTimestamps: No audio timestamps for this version (human-written text; none are invented).
testimony.confirm: Confirm transcript is what I said
testimony.correctionSaved: Correction saved as a new version.
testimony.panelNote: Testimony can explain what happened. It never satisfies a checklist item; the matching delivery document is still required.
testimony.none: No voice notes on this case.
testimony.demo: Send demo voice note (synthetic Marathi, robotic voice)

confirmation.unconfirmed: Unconfirmed — waiting for {{name}} to check it

reviewer.title: Reviewer decisions
reviewer.intro: Decisions are recorded with your identity, the case version and your explanation.
reviewer.modalBody: This gives up the defense. The simulated dispute becomes LOST and {{amount}} (synthetic) may be debited from a later settlement. It is separate from submitting evidence and cannot be undone here.
reviewer.approval: Approval recorded (single use, bound to this case version, expires {{expires}}).
